ATC Vet — QA01AB05; QD01AE05. Profile Polynoxylin is a condensation product of formaldehyde and urea. It is an antiseptic with antibacterial and antifungal actions and, like noxytiolin (p.1654), may act by the release of formalde- hyde. It is used topically for the local treatment of minor infec- tions, usually at a concentration of 10%.
